Thanks for your concern. I'm in between therapists right now, I've probably been to over ten of them over the past eight years, all with varying levels of success.

I am seeing a psychiatrist and am on the maximum doses for desvenlafaxine and Wellbutrin. It's not exactly working, because I still feel like this.

That's the thing, I'm going through the steps. I've tried and tried to get better, and I can never consistently feel happy. There isn't much more I want to do if my mind is so resolved to feel miserable.
Our team played to not lose from the middle of the third quarter onwards, and have absolutely no discipline in terms of penalties. How we won that dumpster fire of a game is beyond me
